description: This file defines a module that provides centralized access to environment variables for a React-based frontend application. It includes a function to read environment variables with fallbacks and exports an immutable configuration object containing key environment variables. Additionally, it exposes a function to retrieve the API base URL.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable by key, returning a fallback value if the variable is not set or not a string.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl()
methods.description: Returns the configured API base URL, falling back to other environment variables if necessary.
